```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(Seurat)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggbeeswarm)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)
library(egg)
library(Polychrome)
library(clustree)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(workflowr)
library(here)
library(sessioninfo)

source(here("code", "load_colour_schemes.R"))
source(here("code", "helper_functions.R"))

RERUN_ALL <- FALSE
```

# Load the dataset

```{r}
# https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE220994
# https://www.nature.com/articles/s41591-024-02807-z

metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "GSE220994_AF_scRNAseq_metadata.csv"))
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$Barcode

seu <- readRDS(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "GSE220994_AF_scRNAseq_seurat_object.rds"))
seu@meta.data <- cbind(seu@meta.data, 
                       metadata[rownames(seu@meta.data),
                                c("orig_sample", "gender", "PCW", "Trimester")])
rmarkdown::paged_table(seu@meta.data)
```

```{r}
# change the assay to RNA
DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"

seu$Dataset_Source <- "Gerli_et_al_2024"
seu$cmv_status <- "negative"
seu$karyotype <- "normal"
seu$num_captures <- NA
seu$sample_type <- NA
seu$sc_sn_performed <- NA
seu$sample_cleaning <- NA

seu$Barcode <- colnames(seu)

dim(seu)
```

```{r}
# relabel metadata to match our datasets

# Donor and Sample
seu$Donor <- seu$orig_sample
seu$Sample <- seu$orig_sample
seu$orig_sample <- NULL

# Gestational Age
seu$gest_age_weeks <- seu$PCW + 2 # gestational age =  PCW + 2 
# https://neonataltherapists.com/using-correct-terminology-in-the-nicu/

# Foetal Sex
seu$foetal_sex <- seu$gender
seu$gender <- NULL

seu$Donor.gest_age <- factor(seu$Donor)
seu$early_late_gestation <- ifelse(seu$gest_age_weeks <= 19, "Early",
                              ifelse(seu$gest_age_weeks >= 23, "Late", 
                                     "Mid"))
```

```{r}
table(seu$Donor, seu$early_late_gestation)
table(seu$Donor, seu$gest_age_weeks)
```

# Quality Control Metrics

```{r, fig.width=15, fig.height=5}
seu@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Donor,
             fill = Donor)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat="count", aes(label = ..count..), vjust = -0.25) +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  NoLegend() +
  ggtitle("Number of cells per sample") +
  rotate_x_labels +
  ylab("Count") -> p1

seu@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Donor,
             y = nCount_RNA)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "area") +
  geom_quasirandom(aes(color = Donor)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  NoLegend() +
  rotate_x_labels +
  ggtitle("QC metrics for all datasets") -> p2

seu@meta.data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Donor,
             y = nFeature_RNA)) +
  geom_violin(scale = "area") +
  geom_quasirandom(aes(color = Donor)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_cowplot(12) +
  rotate_x_labels +
  NoLegend() -> p3

p1 | p2 | p3
```

# Foetal Sex

```{r}
# Some samples are missing foetal sex metadata
table(seu$Donor, seu$foetal_sex)
```

```{r}
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("XIST", "TSIX"), group.by = "Donor", assay = "RNA")
VlnPlot(seu, features = c("SRY", "ZFY"), group.by = "Donor", assay = "RNA")
```

```{r}
# update missing sex values with predicted foetal sex based on gene expression
seu$foetal_sex <- ifelse(seu$Donor %in% c("14PCW_713", "17PCW_719"), "Female", seu$foetal_sex)
seu$foetal_sex <- ifelse(seu$Donor == "19PCW_725", "Male", seu$foetal_sex)

table(seu$Donor, seu$foetal_sex)
```

# Perform cell type annotation using *Celltypist*

```{r}
# extract counts matrix from Seurat object
object <- here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "Gerli_et_al_2024.Counts.csv")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  seu_counts <- GetAssayData(seu[["RNA"]], "counts")
  write.csv(seu_counts, object)
}
```

```{r}
# Load in the Celltypist results
object <- here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "Gerli_et_al_2024.Celltypist_annotated.Seurat.rds")
if (!file.exists(object) | RERUN_ALL) {
  # Add the pan_fetal reference results
  predicted_labels <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_Gerli_et_al_2024_pan_fetal", "predicted_labels.csv"))
  probability_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_Gerli_et_al_2024_pan_fetal", "probability_matrix.csv"))
  decision_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_Gerli_et_al_2024_pan_fetal", "decision_matrix.csv"))
  
  predicted_labels <- createCelltypistResultsDF(predicted_labels, probability_matrix, decision_matrix, 
                                                ref_name = "pan_fetal")
  predicted_labels <- predicted_labels[colnames(seu),] # reorder to ensure names match Seurat object
  seu <- AddMetaData(seu, predicted_labels)
  
  predicted_labels <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_Gerli_et_al_2024_fetal_organ", "predicted_labels.csv"))
  probability_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_Gerli_et_al_2024_fetal_organ", "probability_matrix.csv"))
  decision_matrix <- read.csv(here("celltypist", "output_Gerli_et_al_2024_fetal_organ", "decision_matrix.csv"))
    
  predicted_labels <- createCelltypistResultsDF(predicted_labels, probability_matrix, decision_matrix, 
                                                ref_name = "fetal_organ")
    
  predicted_labels <- predicted_labels[colnames(seu),] # reorder to ensure names match Seurat object
  seu <- AddMetaData(seu, predicted_labels)
  
  seu$pan_fetal.predicted_labels <- sortedFactor(seu$pan_fetal.predicted_labels)
  seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting <- sortedFactor(seu$pan_fetal.majority_voting)
  seu$fetal_organ.predicted_labels <- sortedFactor(seu$fetal_organ.predicted_labels)
  seu$fetal_organ.majority_voting <- sortedFactor(seu$fetal_organ.majority_voting)
  
  # Add batch information into the object (from R script used in paper)
  combined_metadata <- read.csv(here("data", "Gerli_et_al_2024", "combined_metadata.csv"))
  rownames(combined_metadata) <- combined_metadata$Sample
  seu$Dataset <- combined_metadata[seu$Sample,]$dataset_batch
  
  saveRDS(seu, object)
} else {
  seu <- readRDS(object)
}
```
